scientific.integrity: The centered theorem follows from an exact norm identity and a sharp Kantorovich-type angle bound with an explicit two-eigenvalue equality witness. The shifted boundary is derived from the exact official scalar update and an explicit logarithmic conjugacy.
limitations: The square-root-conditioned guarantee is a sharp worst-case one-step Euclidean bound, not a claimed exact asymptotic rate for every trajectory.
The centered result is not translation invariant; a shifted scalar minimizer need not be approached.
The shifted rotation classification assumes positive states and learning rate strictly between zero and one.
Stochastic gradients, momentum, multiple blocks, weight decay, and bounded-parameter projection are outside scope.

title: Sharp origin-dependence dichotomy for Fromage on quadratics
